newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN AIR 1996 TURNOVER 365 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN AIR 1996 TURNOVER 365 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Estonian Air said on Wednesday that its 1996 turnover was 365 million kroons vs 309 million kroons in 1995.
The company, which is 66 percent owned by Denmark's Maersk Air and local investment group Baltic Cresco, also forecast a turnover of 509 million kroons for 1997.
"Based on first quarter results we are on target for the 500 million figure," Borge Thornbech, president of Estonian Air, told a group of journalists.
Thornbech declined to say what the company's first quarter results were.
"Our first quarter figures are in line with our budget predictions," he added.
The company did not make a proft in 1996 and is not expected to bring a profit until the year 1999.
"We will make a loss this year and next year, and we predict that will make a profit in 1999," Thornbech said.
"This is a normal situation in turin a company around," he said.
The company never reveals its financial figures.
Estonian Air was privatised in 1996 and has been pursuing an ambitious moderisation programme.
The Estonian government retains a 34 percent stake in the company with Maersh Air holding 49 percent and Baltic Cresco the remaining 17 percent.
